'''Blanked:''' The Players Committee's Competitive Balance Team blanked this card with the errata posted on 11 April 2012 and legal from 20 April 2012, “until it is re-virtualized by Design”; it was re-virtualized in Virtual Block 8.2 as [[Captain Verrack (V)]]. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
